title: Minimum height for D
description: Essential: The release height h must be correctly given as 3R/2 for the ball to just pass point D.

title: Friction force at C
description: Essential: The frictional force exerted by the ground when the ball is at point C must be identified as 3mg (or equivalent) with correct direction.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy (or work-energy theorem) correctly between release and points C or D.

title: Circular motion condition
description: Important: For part (1), the condition for circular motion at the top (point D) must be stated or used (e.g., N ≥ 0 leading to v_D² ≥ gR).

title: Normal force at C
description: Important: For part (2), the calculation of the normal force from the ball on the block at point C using Newton's second law for circular motion must be shown.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: For part (3), the analysis of projectile motion from D to the incline AE must be set up correctly with horizontal and vertical components.

title: Height range for landing
description: Essential: For part (3), the final answer must correctly state the range of release heights (3R/2 ≤ h ≤ 3R/2 + √3 R/4).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in energy equation (e.g., wrong potential energy reference) or wrong direction for friction/normal force.

title: Geometry oversight
description: Pitfall: Failing to use the correct geometry (e.g., the 30° incline, horizontal distance from D to E) in the projectile motion calculation for part (3).
